newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia buys seven U.S. "Blackhawk" helicopters.
newsitem.headline: Colombia buys seven U.S. "Blackhawk" helicopters.

text.p: Colombia's Defense Ministry said on Friday it had bought seven U.S.-made UH-60 "Blackhawk" helicopters to help boost the government's fight against leftist guerrillas.
A brief ministry statement announcing the purchase did not detail the cost, but ministry sources said the seven aircraft had a total price of $64.2 million.
The "Blackhawk" helicopter is manufactured by United Technologies Corp.'s Sikorsky Aircraft division.
Last week the Defense Ministry announced the purchase of 10 Mi-17 Russian helicopters for operational troop lifts for a total of $42.8 million.

Western military experts say the Colombian military's serious shortage of air mobility is one reason it has lost momentum in a low-intensity war against three leftist guerrilla groups that have been operating across the country since the 1960s.
